P2_f3v.interpretation: f3v shows 8 nodes left / 13 right, alternation 0.15, spacing CV 0.44. Its spacing is more regular than 36% of plants.
P2_f3v.honest_note: Regular opposite/decussate leaf pairs are a common real botanical arrangement and a common stylisation in medieval herbals. A DNA/molecule/compound reading is not possible: those are post-1800 (molecular structure) and post-1950 (DNA) concepts, centuries after this vellum (1404-1438). We report the geometry; the molecular interpretation is ruled out by chronology, not by the drawing.

P3_drawing_as_code.reading: If the drawing were a code, leaf-counts should be structured (low-entropy sequence) and/or linked to the text. High entropy + near-zero text correlation = the leaf geometry does not carry a recoverable message tied to the page.
